Monash University, Melbourne, VIC

---

Detail-oriented Business Analyst and a student at [Monash University](https://www.monash.edu/) with a solid foundation in Computer Science and Data Management. Skilled in R (tidyverse), SQL, Power BI, Advanced Excel, and Python for statistical modeling and process optimization. Proven track record in project leadership, translating complex data into actionable business insights, and operating effectively in fast-paced environments.

I have a keen understanding in creating data piplelines and data exploration with a great understanding in statistics foundational topics. Leading projects and exploring new ideas in a broad variety of subjects is my hobby.
